annotation.title_clean: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 8 July 2026 amending Regulations (EU) 2024/1689, (EU) 2018/1139 and (EU) 2023/1230 as regards the simplification of the implementation of harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Digital Omnibus on AI)
annotation.title_en: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 amending Regulations (EU) 2024/1689, (EU) 2018/1139 and (EU) 2023/1230 as regards the simplification of the implementation of harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Digital Omnibus on AI)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: The Digital Omnibus on AI amends the EU AI Act, the Civil Aviation Regulation and the Machinery Regulation. It delays high-risk obligations to December 2027 and August 2028 and moves machinery to the sectoral Annex I Section B. It narrows the 'safety component' definition, extends SME relief to small mid-caps, adds prohibitions on nudification and child sexual abuse material (CSAM) generation, and strengthens AI Office enforcement and sandboxes.
key_provisions_or_claims: High-risk AI obligations delayed to 2 December 2027 (Annex III) and 2 August 2028 (Annex I products).
Machinery Regulation 2023/1230 moved to Annex I Section B; delegated acts to add AI-specific essential safety requirements by 2 August 2028.
'Safety component' redefined by intended safety function; convenience, optimisation and quality-control AI excluded.
New Article 5 prohibitions on AI generating non-consensual intimate material and CSAM, applying from 2 December 2026.
AI Office gets exclusive supervisory and fining powers over GPAI-based systems and AI in very large platforms; sandboxes and real-world testing extended to Annex I products.
